Definition: properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
BiblicalUsage: subst; 1) higher part, upper part; adv; 1a) above; prep; 1b) on the top of, above, on higher ground than; with locative; 1c) upwards, higher, above
